scenarios.name: main
scenarios.description: Five metrics (three trading, two corporate, one unavailable) over twelve peers: a deliberate score tie, a below-coverage miner, a partially covered miner that still ranks, and an unavailable metric that can never be activated.

metrics.label: Room before interest bites
metrics.reason: resilience is computed on Our View inputs

scenarios.name: stability
scenarios.description: Two anti-correlated metrics over twelve miners that all score 50.0 at a 50/50 split — the most fragile ordering possible, so the stability probe must fire; with the whole budget on one metric it must go quiet.

stability.label: EV/EBITDA
stability.message: Shifting 'EV/EBITDA' by 10 points moves the rank by 6 places — treat this ordering as fragile.

scenarios.name: thin_cohort
scenarios.description: Twelve miners of which five carry only one metric: one active metric ranks everybody, a second active metric drops the cohort under min_eligible_peers and the whole result becomes the 'not enough comparable miners' notice.

expected.message: Not enough comparable miners — 7 have enough of your metrics and at least 10 are needed.
expected.announcement: Not enough comparable miners for this combination of metrics.

scenarios.name: subject_unranked
scenarios.description: The subject itself falls below the coverage floor once a second metric is active: the list still ranks its peers, but the subject shows the truthful 'has 1 of your 2 metrics' instead of a score it has not earned.

expected.announcement: NEM is not ranked — has 1 of your 2 metrics
NEM is not ranked — has 1 of your 3 metrics

scenarios.name: edges
scenarios.description: Five available metrics over twelve miners, sitting on two exact boundaries: a miner with exactly 3 of 5 metrics (0.6, the coverage floor, which must rank) beside one with 2 of 5 (0.4, which must not), and a subject percentile whose contribution lands on an exact negative half.

stability.label: Down beta
stability.message: Shifting 'Down beta' by 10 points moves the rank by 4 places — treat this ordering as fragile.

scenarios.name: peer_floor
scenarios.description: Lands on min_eligible_peers exactly: the second metric leaves precisely ten ranked miners, which is enough. If that comparison ever slips from 'fewer than ten' to 'ten or fewer', this scenario is what notices.
